claim.statement: Cognition's Devin Desktop FAQ says the renamed Desktop product retains the IDE/editor and features, distinguishes Devin Cloud as a separate product, and states that existing Cascade would remain available through July.

source.title: Devin Desktop FAQ
source.locator: What is Devin Desktop?; what happens to Windsurf?; Cascade availability; Devin Cloud distinction

lifecycle.reason: Current FAQ preserves a dated transition plan without a service-revision identifier.

limitations: The July statement is a planned availability boundary, not proof that Cascade ceased service.
The FAQ's Desktop and Cloud distinction prevents transferring this local-client evidence to hosted Devin.
unknowns: Whether the planned Cascade transition schedule changed, and Cascade's post-July service status or revision, are unresolved.

relationships.note: The FAQ planned existing Cascade availability through July, while current post-July documentation still lists Cascade as a Devin Desktop local agent; no attributable correction or scope explanation resolves the timing.
